events.summary: Customer asks to prepare two separate bookings (4500 today, 4500 tomorrow) to the same supplier, but these reflect two independent real invoices for different deliveries with full transparency, not an attempt to dodge the 8000-franc internal approval rule which already covers the whole connected process.
